description: Kaggle usernames to follow, for conservative/ToS-safe visibility building. follow_users.py reads only the `users` array; the other keys document how to curate it. Leave `users` empty until you (or an explicit go-ahead) add real, verified, relevant peers per selection_criteria. Do NOT bulk-add.
selection_criteria: Co-competitors visible on the public leaderboards of boards you have entered
Authors of notebooks/datasets you have genuinely upvoted
Active participants in discussion threads you join
Plausibly reciprocal peers (similar level/topics) -- not Grandmasters who rarely follow back, not random accounts

guardrails.run_mode: manual / headed only -- never an unattended tight loop
guardrails.rationale: Bulk automated following is a Kaggle ToS gray area that can flag/suspend the account the whole medal effort depends on. Pace and genuineness are the guardrails.

candidate_sources: kaggle competitions leaderboard <competition> --show  (verify display names map to real usernames before adding)
Profiles of people you upvote while reading notebooks/datasets
Discussion threads on boards you actively compete in
